title: Building back better and stronger in Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
temporal_coverage: Beryl impacts in 2024 and recovery outputs through 2025.
limitations: Reported outputs; no attribution of Beryl to climate change or independent impact evaluation.

title: St. Vincent and the Grenadines Secures $20 Million to Strengthen Disaster Resilience
temporal_coverage: Risk diagnosis and policy financing announced inApril2025.
limitations: Policy commitments and credit availability are not evaluated resilience outcomes.

title: UNDP part of multi-agency response to Hurricane Beryl
limitations: Reported support and training; no independent causal or peacebuilding evaluation.

title: Hurricane Beryl 2024: Global Rapid Post-Disaster Damage Estimation (GRADE) Report
organization: World Bank Group and Global Facility for Disaster Reduction and Recovery
temporal_coverage: Rapid direct-damage assessment following Hurricane Beryl on 1 July 2024; report as of 26 July 2024.
methodology: Rapid engineering-based damage estimation using reported assessments, exposure data, satellite imagery and modeled wind fields.
limitations: Preliminary rapid estimates; damage to buildings on Saint Vincent was not disaggregated by census division or damage level.

title: National Climate Change Policy of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines
organization: Government of Saint Vincent and the Grenadines; prepared with technical assistance from CANARI
temporal_coverage: Policy priority period 2018–2030; vulnerability narrative draws on historical events and farmer observations through 2019.
methodology: Government policy document informed by literature, climate modeling and three rounds of stakeholder consultation during 2018–2019.
limitations: The document mixes historical observations with policy priorities; stated actions are not evidence of implementation or current outcomes.

title: Saint Vincent and the Grenadines on the Path to Recovery with support from UNDP, Canada and CDEMA
organization: United Nations Development Programme, Barbados and the Eastern Caribbean
temporal_coverage: Post-Beryl recovery activities, including workshops in November 2025 and March 2026.
methodology: UNDP news account of partner-supported post-disaster training and school-equipment activities.
limitations: Implementer-reported outputs; the page provides no independent evaluation of preparedness or resilience effects.

title: Building Resilience with Frontier Technology: Union Island’s 3D Printing and Design Capacity Building
organization: United Nations Development Programme Accelerator Lab, Barbados and the Eastern Caribbean
temporal_coverage: Workshop and printer handover in November 2025; blog published 16 December 2025.
methodology: UNDP Accelerator Lab account of a local design-and-fabrication workshop and stakeholder engagement.
limitations: This is a programme blog; intended local-use cases are not evidence of tested emergency response or measured climate outcomes.
